snippet.title: The Driver Syndicate - "Take A Ride" At Day - 80 Mustang Fastback
snippet.description:
Just like last week I drove the 80s Mustang, this time it will be the 80s Mustang Fastback. I wonder what this car can do. Only one way to fine out, drivers! Let's get to it! Enjoy the video!

If you want to be in a group together to discuss more about The Driver Syndicate, please join our Group Chat Server on Discord "Driver Madness."
